name: 3D eye-tracking video saliency benchmark
description: A three-dimensional eye-tracking dataset and benchmark for evaluating visual saliency prediction on stereoscopic 3D video.
evaluation_method: AUC / NSS / CC / KL divergence (common saliency metrics)
reputation: A specialized, moderate-recognition dataset in the visual saliency community for stereoscopic 3D video; cited in niche saliency and 3D vision work.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on visual saliency with stereoscopic video and eye-tracking; dataset size is limited compared to 2D video saliency corpora, so risk of overfitting and limited generalization to broader video domains.
